title: West Pakistan Co-Operative Development Board Ordinance 1962

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Co-Operative Development Board Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Short title and extent

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD
ORDINANCE, 1962
CHAPTER I‑PRELIMINARY
1. Short title and extent.‑(I) This Ordinance
may be called the West Pakistan Co‑operative Development Board Ordinance,
1962.
(2) It extends to the whole of the Province of West
Pakistan, except the Special Areas.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Co-Operative Development Board Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Definitions

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD
ORDINANCE, 1962
CHAPTER I‑PRELIMINARY
2. Definitions.‑
In this Ordinance, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject, or context‑
(a) "Board" means the West Pakistan Co‑operative
Development Board established under section 3 ;
(b) "Chairman" means
the Chairman of the Board ;
(c) "member" means a
member of the Board;
(d) "Government" means the Government of West Pakistan ;
(e) "rules" and "regulations"
mean respectively the rules and regula tions made under this Ordinance ;
(f )
"Registrar" means a person appointed to perform the duties of a
Registrar of Co‑operative Societies under any law relating to co‑operative
societies in force in West Pakistan; and
(g) "Union" means the
West Pakistan Co‑operative Union.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Co-Operative Development Board Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Establishment and incorporation of the board

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD
ORDINANCE, 1962
CHAPTER II-CONSTITUTION OF THE
BOARD
3. Establishment and Incorporation of the
Board.‑(1) As soon as may be after the commencement of this
Ordinance, Government shall establish a Board to be called the West Pakistan Co‑operative
Development Board.
(2) The Board shall be a body corporate, having
perpetual succession and a common seal, with power to enter into contracts and
to acquire and hold property, both movable and immovable, and shall, by the
said name, sue and be sued.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Co-Operative Development Board Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Constitution of the board

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD
ORDINANCE, 1962
CHAPTER II-CONSTITUTION OF THE
BOARD
4. Constitution of the Board.‑(1) The
Board shall consist of‑---
(a) a
Chairman ; and
(b) not more than ten other members.
(2) The Chairman and not more than half of the other
members shall be appointed by Government, and the remaining members shall be
appointed by the Union.
(3) The Chairman and the members appointed by
Government shall hold office during the pleasure of the Governor. on such terms
and condi tions, and shall receive such remuneration and allowances, as may be
determined by Government.
(4) The
members appointed by the Union shall hold office for two years, and receive
such allowances as may be determined by the Board.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Co-Operative Development Board Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Removal and resignation of members

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD
ORDINANCE, 1962
CHAPTER II-CONSTITUTION OF THE
BOARD
5. Removal and resignation of members.‑(I)
A member appointed by the Union may resign his office by tendering his
resignation to the Chairman, and the seat of such member shall become vacant
when the resignation is accepted by the authority specified in this behalf in
the rules.
(2) Government may at any time remove a member
appointed by the Union if he‑--
(a) refuses or fails to discharge or becomes, in the
opinion of Government, incapable of performing his duties under this Ordi nance
; or
(b) has, in the opinion of Government, abused his
position as member; or
(c) has
absented himself from three consecutive meetings of the Board without the leave of the Chairman
Provided that a member shall not be removed under the
provisions of this subsection without first giving him an opportunity of
showing cause against his removal.
(3) A member removed from office under the provisions
of sub section (2) shall not be re-appointed as a member until the expiration
of three years from the date op his removal.
(4) A
person appointed as a member by virtue of his holding a particular office shall
cease to be the member on his ceasing to hold that office and his successor in
office shall be deemed to have been
appointed in his place.
(5) Where a member is removed from office under the
provisions of subsection (2), or the Chairman or a member dies or resigns or
his office falls vacant for any other reason, the vacancy shall be filled, in
the case of the Chairman, by Government, and in the case of any other member,
by $be authority by which such member was appointed.

sections.description:
Meeting of the board

WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD

6. Meetings of the Board ‑The meetings of the
Board shall be held at such times and at such places and in accordance with
such procedure as may be provided in the regulations;
Provided that until the regulations are framed, such
meetings shall be convened by the Chairman.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Co-Operative Development Board Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Functions of the board

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD
ORDINANCE, 1962
CHAPTER III‑‑‑POWERS,
DUTIES AND FUNCTIONS OF THE BOARD
7. Functions of
the Board.‑The Board shall perform the following functions :‑
(a) promote the organization of
co‑operative societies of all types ;
(b) encourage, assist in and supervise the
development of co‑operative societies ;
(c) take over and manage the affairs of co‑operative
societies as and when required to do so by the Registrar under any law relating
to co operative societies 9n force in the Province or any part thereof ;
(d) carry out survey of new
projects in the co‑operative field ;
(e) arrange for research and
collection of statistics ; and
(f) do all such things as are incidental or conducive
to the healthy development of the Co‑operative Movement in the Province.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Co-Operative Development Board Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Appointment of officers etc

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD
ORDINANCE, 1962
CHAPTER III‑‑‑POWERS,
DUTIES AND FUNCTIONS OF THE BOARD
8. Appointment of officers,
etc.‑Subject to the regulations‑
(i) the Board may appoint such officers, advisers and
servants as it considers necessary for the efficient performance of its
functions, on such terms and conditions as it may deem fit ; and
(ii) the Chairman may, for the due performance of the
functions entrusted to the Board under this Ordinance, in case of urgency,
appoint such officers, advisers or servants and on such terms and conditions as
he may think fit ; provided that every such appointment shall be reported to
the Board without unreasonable delay and shall not continue beyond six months
unless approved by the Board.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Co-Operative Development Board Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Recruitment conditions of service etc of officers and servants

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD
ORDINANCE, 1962
CHAPTER III‑‑‑POWERS,
DUTIES AND FUNCTIONS OF THE BOARD
9. Recruitment, conditions of service, etc., of officers and servants. (1) The procedure for
the appointment of the officers and servants of the Board and the terms and
conditions of their service shall be such as may be provided by regulations.
(2) Subject to the rules and regulations, the Board
shall be competent to take disciplinary action against its officers and
servants.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Co-Operative Development Board Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Government may require returns reports etc

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962

CHAPTER III‑‑‑POWERS,
DUTIES AND FUNCTIONS OF THE BOARD
10. Government may require returns, reports, etc.‑Government
may require the Board to furnish any returns, statements, statistics or other
information regarding any matter under the control of the Board and the Board
shall comply with any such requisition without undue delay.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Co-Operative Development Board Ordinance 1962

Delegation of powers

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962

WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD

CHAPTER III‑‑‑POWERS,
DUTIES AND FUNCTIONS OF THE BOARD
11. Delegation of powers.‑The
Board may delegate to the Chairman, or
any member or committee or officer of the Board, any of its powers under this
Ordinance or the rules and regulations.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Co-Operative Development Board Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Board's fund

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD
ORDINANCE, 1962
CHAPTER IV‑FINANCE
12. Board's Fund.‑(1) There shall be a fund to
be known as the "Board's Fund" vested in the Board, which shall be
utilized by the Board to meet charges in connection with its functions under
this Ordinance, Including the payment of salaries and other remunerations to
the Chairman, members, officers, advisers and servants of the Board.
(2) The Board's Fund shall consist of‑--
(a) grants made by the Central
Government, the Provincial Government and the State Bank of Pakistan ;
(b) loans obtained from Government and the State Bank of
Pakistan ;
(c) loans and grants obtained from a foreign agency
with the special or general sanction of Government ;
(d) fees and contributions received from co‑operative
societies s and
(e) all other sums received by the Board.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Co-Operative Development Board Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Powers of the board to borrow money

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD
ORDINANCE, 1962
CHAPTER IV‑FINANCE
13. Powers of
the Board to borrow money.‑The Board shall be deemed to be a local
authority under the Local Authorities Loans Act, 1914, for the purposes of
borrowing money under that .Act, and the making and execution of any scheme or
project under this Ordinance shall be deemed to be a work which such authority
is legally authorised to carry out:
Provided that no foreign loan shall be obtained by
the Board without the previous sanction
of Government.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Co-Operative Development Board Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Custody and investment of fund

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD
ORDINANCE, 1962
CHAPTER IV‑FINANCE
14. Custody and investment of Fund.‑(1) The Board may keep
its moneys In any treasury, sub‑treasury or a bank approved by
Government.
(2) Nothing in subsection (1) shall be deemed to
preclude the Board from investing any
such moneys which are not required for Immediate expenditure in any of the
securities described in section 20 of the Trusts Act, 1882, or placing them In
fixed deposit with a bank approved by Government.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Co-Operative Development Board Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Budget

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD
ORDINANCE, 1962
CHAPTER V‑AUDIT AND ACCOUNTS
15. Budget.‑(1)
In the month of January each year or at such other time as Government may
specify in this behalf, the Board shall submit to Government for approval A'
statement of the estimated receipts and expendi ture in respect of the next
financial year.
(2) The Board shall obtain specific sanction of
Government In respect of such schemes as Government may specify in this behalf.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Co-Operative Development Board Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Accounts and audit

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD
ORDINANCE, 1962
CHAPTER V‑AUDIT AND ACCOUNTS
16. Accounts
and audit.‑(1) The Board shall maintain proper accounts and rather
relevant records and prepare annual statement of accounts, in accordance with
such general directions as may be issued, and in such form as may be specified
by Government.
(2) The accounts of the Board shall be audited by an
auditor who shall be a Chartered Accountant within the meaning of the Chartered
Accountants Ordinance, 1961, and appointed for the purpose by the Board with
the prior approval of Government.
(3) Notwithstanding the audit provided for to
subsection (2), the Auditor‑General may independently audit or cause to
be audited the accounts of the Board.
(4) The Board shall produce all accounts, books and
documents, and furnish such explanations and Information as the auditor
appointed under this section may require for the purpose of audit.
(5) The auditor shall report to Government upon the
annual balance -sheet and accounts of the Board, and In his report shall state
whether in his opinion the balance‑sheet is a full and fair balance‑sleet
containing ail necessary particulars and properly drawn up so as to exhibit a
true and correct view of the Board's affairs, and in case he has called for any
explanation or information from the Board, whether it has been given and
whether it is satisfactory.
(6) Government may at An v time issue directions to
the auditor requiring him to report to it upon the adequacy of the measure
taken by the Board for the protection
of the Interests of Government and of the creditors of the Board or upon the
sufficiency of his procedure in auditing the affairs of the Board, and may at
any time enlarge or extend the scope of the audit or direct that a different
procedure in audit be adopted or that any other examination be made by the
auditor, if In its opinion the public interest so requires.
(7) The Board shall comply with every direction
Issued by Government for the rectification of matters objected to in audit.

17. Annual report.‑The Board shall, as soon as
possible after the end of every financial year, submit an annual report to
Government on the conduct of its affairs for that year.

Chairman etc deemed to be public servants

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD
ORDINANCE, 1962
CHAPTER VI‑GENERAL
18. Chairman, etc., deemed to be public servants.‑The
Chairman, every member and every officer, adviser and servant of the Board,
shall be deemed to be a public servant within the meaning of section 21 of the
Pakistan Penal Code.

Contribution by the board towards leave pension etc

WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD
ORDINANCE, 1962
CHAPTER VI‑GENERAL
19. Contribution by the Board towards leave, pension, etc.‑The Board shall be
liable to pay such contributions for the leave, allowances and pension of any
person in the service of the Central or Provincial Govern ment, and employed as
Chairman, member, adviser, officer or servant of the Board as may be required
by the conditions of his service under such Government to be paid to him or on
his behalf.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Co-Operative Development Board Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Indemnity to the board the chairman etc

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD

CHAPTER VI‑GENERAL
20. Indemnity to the.
Board, the Chairman, etc.‑No
suit, prosecution or other legal proceedings shall lie against the
Board, the Chairman, any member, officer, adviser or servant of the Board in
respect of anything done In good faith and with due care and attention under
this Ordinance.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Co-Operative Development Board Ordinance 1962

Validation of acts and proceedings

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD
ORDINANCE, 1962
CHAPTER VI‑GENERAL
21. Validation of acts and proceedings.‑No act done or proceed ings taken under this
Ordinance shall be questioned on the ground merely of‑---
(a) the existence of any vacancy in, or any defect in
the constitution of, the Board ; or
(b) any person who has ceased to be a member having
continued to act as such.

sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Co-Operative Development Board Ordinance 1962
sections.description:
Power to make regulations

ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
ORDINANCE XIV OF 1962
WEST PAKISTAN CO‑OPERATIVE DEVELOPMENT BOARD
ORDINANCE, 1962
CHAPTER VII‑RULES AND
REGULATIONS
22. Power to make
regulations.‑(1) Subject to the provisions of this Ordinance, the
Board may, with the previous approval of Government, make regulations not
inconsistent with the rules for carrying out tile pur poses of this Ordinance.
(2) In particular, and without prejudice to the
generality of the fore going powers, such regulations may provide for‑
(a) the appointment of committees of the Board to
consider specific matters ;
(b) the investment of moneys by
the Board ;
(c) the procedure to be
followed at meetings of the Board, and
the Board of its and projects ;
(d) the
method of ensuring continuous evaluation by the Board of its schemes and
projects;
(e) the determination of the terms and conditions of service of the
officers and servants of the Board;
(f) the mode of operation and expenditure of the
funds of the Board ; and
(g) any other matter required by this Ordinance to be
provided by regulations.
